title: The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 2
author: H. P. Blavatsky
description: The Secret Doctrine, Volume 2, by H. P. Blavatsky, from the multi-volume edition of her 1888 magnum opus. This part continues the exposition of Cosmogenesis with its extensive commentary on symbolism: the 'Symbolism of the Archaic Teachings' explores the universal language of myth and the esoteric meaning of the primordial symbols, among them the egg, the lotus, the cross and circle, the serpent and dragon, the Deluge and the sacred numbers and geometry, together with the doctrine of the Logos and of the hierarchies of spiritual beings, as well as science versus occultism on matter, force and the ether. Blavatsky compares Hindu, Chaldean, Egyptian, Kabbalistic and Christian traditions to argue for a single primordial wisdom religion. Because volume divisions differ between editions, readers should check the table of contents for the exact sections included.
